create_agent_subclass: create a subclass of BaseAgent that implements perceive, controller_step, task_step, and handle_exception methods
run_agent_loop: run the BaseAgent start method to begin the perpetual step loop until shutdown
implement_perceive_method: implement the perceive method to gather world information and store it in agent memory
implement_controller_step: implement the controller_step method to interpret commands and place tasks on the task stack
implement_task_step: implement the task_step method to execute the topmost task and interact with the world
